about: INTEGRATE1f part f1 (the integration design §5.9; D192's runner contract, extended; D215's notes on INTEGRATE1j): a repository's runner answer read as D192 judges it, and more: unknown, never a pass, wherever the file is missing, does not read, names another schema, commit, base or declaration blob, names a gate the accepted declaration does not declare, or lacks a planned gate or holds one ended or not-run. The driver's RunnerAnswers reads every row of 'reads', 'standings' and 'promotions' (RunnerAnswerTests; the sentences are the driver's). The merge tool writes the answers (src/Daoris.Cli/tool-test/integration-runner-answers.test.ts builds each 'written' piece with its own writers and holds it to the answer here), so a field name changed on one side fails the other. A path is neutral, X:/; an object id is made up.
